text: The biggest injustice in the Indian cricket, it wasn't Sanju Samson in and out of the team for years. It wasn't the Shreyas, a year brutally ignored for the Isha Kaff after leading Punjab to a thrilling IPL final.
It is a man you have already forgotten Karun Nair. December 2016 Chennai a mighty England on the other side a quite fearless 25 year old playing on his third test.

The first 100 comes, the crowd erupts, then a glorious 200, the entire stadium rises and then a breathtaking historic 300. 303 not out. Only the second Indian ever to score a test ripples century after the legendary Sahivag.
That magical night a proud nation said the same thing, India has found its next superstar.
But cricket had written a cold heartless script. Within months he was out of the team. No calls, no chance, no explanations. Long, painful year-power selector forgards, fan forgards.
of India was celebrating Ishan Kishan explosive double handed and on the same day a broken desperate Karun quietly typed dear cricket give me one more chance
That same week his own state Kannada cold redopping
that same week his own state Karnataka

coldly dropped him from there and g team 2 and what happened next before you find it out if you are a true cricket fan make sure you follow this page. But Karun didn't break a new state with Arba and then a relentless unstoppable storm of France
and 8 years later the same India that forgot him was forced to call him back now think about it

Only the second Indian ever to score a historic test triple 100, ruthlessly dropped within months abandoned by his own state and a painful lonely 8 year wait to come back. Sanju got changes, Shreya the comeback, Karun waited 8 year long for just one more chance. So tell me, has the Indian cricket failed?
